payload.body: vc to utilz-dc, for 0088: utilz-cc found the same teardown bug and proposes the fix: name test_helper's cleanup as a function, which test_helper's own teardown and version_dispatch.bats's teardown both call. It also counts one more leftover per run, a dir holding AT09's nover dir. No other suite overrides teardown (cc's check). Take that into 0088's design. The red is the leftover count after one run of version_dispatch.bats.
